expectation: codex-native-sdk and DeerFlow/codex-acp both complete one identical read-only fact-extraction task (same two input files copied into each arm's own workspace, same instruction to read them only with `head -c 24000`) and return all gold facts; cumulative provider tokens are of the same order (tens of thousands) and differ mainly by per-backend prompt overhead. OmniRoute is expected NOT to be runnable here: no Linux-side gateway with a Codex OAuth connection exists on this host (the recorded gateway ran on Windows at port 20128 and is not listening).
criteria: Task, input files, gold facts and the scoring script are committed before any arm runs.

Per arm record: facts correct / total (mechanical match against gold), blocked or failed tool calls, cumulative native usage (input, cached input, output, total) from the owning SDK/adapter event, wall time, sandbox policy.
Arms run sequentially, one Codex call at a time, with native hooks disabled (-c features.hooks=false, features.plugin_hooks=false) so no ai-memory hook call reaches the live store.
settled only if all three named backends ran; with OmniRoute blocked the best outcome is advanced.
A backend whose returned facts cannot be scored or whose usage is unavailable is reported as such, not imputed.
